title: Primary Bulwark
summary: Primary Bulwark is an Primary Arcane that grants weapon damage based on the Warframe's Armor.
extract:
Primary Bulwark is an Primary Arcane that grants weapon damage based on the Warframe's Armor.

Effect

Acquisition
Can be bought from Roathe at La Cathédrale in the Sanctum Anatomica for 5  Maphica.
May appear as a Steel Path The Descendia reward on a weekly rotational basis.
Infernum 6 and 13 awards 1.
Infernum 20 awards 3.

Notes
Damage bonus is additive to other base damage buffs like  Serration.
Damage bonus is given by the following: Damage Bonus=min⁡(max⁡(Armor−1000,0),500)×(Damage Bonus Per Armor over 1000)
Damage bonus reaches its cap at 1500 armor for all ranks of the arcane.

Bugs
Damage bonus per rank is rounded to the nearest percent in the UI, giving the appearance of a higher rank arcane only increasing the damage buff cap, not the damage bonus per unit of armor as well.
